name: Durable ACK Authority Convergence
description: Rename/evolve from mission 0021. Every authority decision must converge on durable ACK. No authority claim without observable PGlite backing.
purpose: Authority without durable proof is not authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Every authority decision produces a durable ACK in PGlite before the operation is considered complete.
No capability can be exercised without an observable PGlite record.
Authority decisions are journaled with: decision ID, timestamp, policy, outcome, and evidence chain reference.
Durable ACK convergence is verified as part of every authority operation.
PGlite is the single source of truth for all authority state.
